title: Inferno Blade
description: A powerful fire sword that burns enemies on hit and unleashes the fury of the Nether.
body: The Inferno Blade is a legendary sword forged in the deepest fires of the Nether. Its molten blade burns everything it touches, engulfing enemies in flames with every strike. The weapon radiates intense heat, leaving fiery particles in the air and turning its wielder into a true master of destruction.
